findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms force you to wait three months to be paid, creating a significant cash flow burden.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before I sign. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months to be paid creates a significant cash flow burden, so I propose changing this to: "Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of receipt.". Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
